name: faah
description: Meme sounds on events: FAAAH when tests fail, anime wow when they pass, bruh when Claude asks you something; failed builds, commands, rejected pushes, denials, errors and interruptions on request.

events.title: When to play it
events.description: Comma-separated: tests-failed, tests-passed, asking, build-failed, command-failed, push-rejected, denied, turn-error, interrupted. /faah add|remove changes it too.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: 0 to 4; 1 is the clip as recorded.
